svg.text: #601 Enterprise Banking AI: 29ms Two-Speed Fraud Engine + Wealth RAG + Credit IDP
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Guide · 2,500 TPS Payment Rail (<45ms SLA) · XGBoost + 1.5B Single-Token Scorer (29ms) + Async 72B AML SAR
1. Two-Speed Payment Fraud & AML Architecture (2,500 TPS)
✕ Anti-Pattern: Calling 70B LLM Inline on Payment Switch
• ISO-20022 / Card Switch hard timeout is 45ms; 70B LLM takes 380ms–1,400ms!
• Running 2,500 TPS on 70B would require 180× H200 GPUs ($612,000/mo) and still time out
✓ Production Two-Speed Funnel (29ms Inline + Async 72B SAR)
• Stage 1 (2,500 TPS → 3ms): Redis Feature Store (8ms) + ONNX XGBoost/LightGBM
clears 94% clean payments in 11ms total
• Stage 2 (6% Grey Zone = 150 QPS → 18ms): Qwen2.5-1.5B-FP8 / ModernBERT
Single-Token Logprob Risk Scorer on 2× L40S → Total Inline P99 = 29ms (<45ms SLA!)
• Stage 3 (1.2% Held Alerts = 30 QPS Async): DeepSeek-R1 / 72B drafts full FinCEN
SAR dossier in background, cutting AML analyst review from 42m to 3.5m (-91.7%!)
2. Wealth Advisory Copilot & Corporate Credit IDP
Workload B: 3,000 Wealth RMs Zero-Hallucination Advisory Copilot
• Enforces Pre-Filter Entitlement ACL (#571) so RMs only see licensed fund prospectuses
• Parallel HHEM-2.1 Groundedness Gate (#584) + Aho-Corasick blocks "guaranteed yield"
• Numerical calculations delegated to deterministic Python Quant library (0% math error)
• Fleet: Shares 4× H200 Decode Pool (35 QPS peak across 3,000 RMs)
Workload C: Corporate Credit Loan Spreading (50,000 Audit PDFs/Mo)
• 3-Tier IDP Router (#583) extracts HTML <table rowspan/colspan> with BBox provenance
• Deterministic Accounting Identity Verifier checks Assets == Liabilities + Equity
• Cuts credit memo turnaround from 5 days to 18 minutes at 99.8% balance-sheet parity
• Runs on 2× L40S + 2× H100 + Nightly Tidal H200 Backfill
3. Complete Tier-1 Commercial Bank AI Fleet Sizing & ROI
• Unified Bank Fleet (Serving 2,500 TPS Fraud + 3,000 RMs + 50K Credit Packets): 4× L40S + 2× H100 + 8× H200 = 14 GPUs ($35,600/mo).
• Saves 94.2% vs. naive inline LLM sizing ($612,000/mo) while meeting strict SR 11-7 model risk governance & 29ms payment SLA.
